chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn al-Sarī reported from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
"It is from the sunnah (prophetic tradition), when a man gives the adhan, that he place his two fingers in his ears."

key_terms.أَذَّنَ: gave the adhan, the call to prayer
key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the person or man performing the call
key_terms.السُّنَّةِ: the established prophetic tradition or recommended practice

ai.seo_question: What is the sunnah practice for how a person should give the adhan?
ai.summary: This hadith states a recommended sunnah etiquette for the one who gives the adhan: placing his fingers in his ears. It reflects the transmitted practice connected to the manner and form of calling to salat (prayer).
